facts.fact: The Open Government Data (OGD) Platform, data.gov.in, publishes state/UT-wise PM-KISAN beneficiary datasets, e.g. 'State/UT-wise Details of Beneficiaries DBT mode Received Benefits of PM-KISAN from 2018-19 to 2024-25'
facts.quote: State/UT-wise Details of Beneficiaries Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode Received Benefits of Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) from 2018-19 to 2024-25 | Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India
facts.note: Other state-wise PM-KISAN resources are also on data.gov.in (e.g. 2018-19 to 2022-23, 18th instalment). Whether each resource has an API could not be read (JavaScript page); www.data.gov.in is listed in eval/bot_sources.json, so the bot may now cite it.

facts.fact: pmkisan.gov.in itself publishes a village-wise Beneficiary List, selected by State, District, Sub-District, Block and Village
facts.quote: Select State District * * Select District Sub-District * * Select Sub District Block * * Select Block Village * * Select Village

behaviour: Answers only from its sources: may point to data.gov.in (OGD Platform), which carries state/UT-wise PM-KISAN beneficiary datasets, and to the village-wise Beneficiary List on pmkisan.gov.in, with citation; if its sources do not show such a dataset or API, says it was not found and points to data.gov.in / pmkisan.gov.in.
fail_if: It invents an API endpoint, dataset or URL, or claims pmkisan.gov.in offers an open API without an official source.
summary: data.gov.in has state-wise PM-KISAN datasets (and is now in the bot's source registry); pmkisan.gov.in has a village-wise beneficiary list; no PM-KISAN API confirmed.
